target.title: fix(gateway): dedupe MCP schema conflict warnings
target.body:
Related: #98437

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators can see repeated MCP loopback `conflicting schema definitions` warnings every time loopback tool schemas are rebuilt for different request/session contexts. The warnings describe the same field-level first-shape fallback over and over, which can bury more useful Gateway diagnostics during restart or session churn.

AI-assisted: this PR was prepared with Codex. I understand the change: it preserves the existing schema-flattening behavior and narrows only duplicate warning emission for repeated field conflicts.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Gateway MCP schema projection already keeps the first schema variant when union object fields conflict. This change keeps that diagnostic signal, but emits it once per conflicting field for the process lifetime instead of once per schema rebuild/cache miss.

The fix stays in the Gateway schema projection layer and does not rename tool fields, change MCP input schemas, add config, or alter malformed-schema warnings.

## User Impact

Operators should see far less repeated MCP loopback warning noise while retaining one warning for each conflicting field name. MCP clients continue to receive the same flattened object schema and first-variant precedence as before.

## Evidence

Focused proof run on the dedicated sweep worktree:

```text
PATH=/Users/harjothk/.nvm/versions/node/v22.19.0/bin:$PATH node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/mcp-http.test.ts

Test Files  4 passed (4)
Tests  224 passed (224)
```

Additional local checks:

```text
git diff --check
# passed with no output
```

Autoreview:

```text
autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported
overall: patch is correct (0.88)
```

What was not tested: I did not run a live multi-hour Gateway log-volume capture or a negative-control proof harness on unfixed `main`; this is why the PR is opened as draft. The focused test drives the real `buildMcpToolSchema` path three times with repeated conflicting union fields and verifies the schema output is preserved while duplicate conflict warnings collapse to one per field.
